_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); analog semiconductor signals; the listing and short-history bounds rules (AVGO)

pit_profile.why: Broadcom: 'We are a global technology leader that designs, develops and supplies a broad range of semiconductor and semiconductor-based solutions and infrastructure software solutions', 'We have two reportable segments: semiconductor solutions and infrastructure software', and 'We operate a primarily outsourced manufacturing business model' (its own FY2025 10-K); 'The markets in which we participate are highly competitive', and 'We operate in a highly cyclical semiconductor industry that is undergoing profound change due to AI': a cyclical and competitive risk, not an obsolescence one

theme_watch.reason: Live: the company's own FY2025 10-K says 'the shift to cloud-based IT solutions and services, such as hyperscale computing, which may adversely affect the timing and volume of sales of our semiconductor products for use in enterprise data centers'. At the same time it sells into data centers itself: 'We offer a broad set of Ethernet switching and routing products that are optimized for enterprise and AI data center, service provider and enterprise networks'. The stock trades at 68.4x FY26E — a premium. Re-file as DISRUPTION_EXPOSED (CLOUD) only if dated evidence shows the market pricing cloud substitution of its enterprise storage and networking specifically.

classification.quality_note: Broadcom: 'We are a global technology leader that designs, develops and supplies a broad range of semiconductor and semiconductor-based solutions and infrastructure software solutions', 'We have two reportable segments: semiconductor solutions and infrastructure software', and 'We operate a primarily outsourced manufacturing business model' (its own FY2025 10-K); 'The markets in which we participate are highly competitive', and 'We operate in a highly cyclical semiconductor industry that is undergoing profound change due to AI': a cyclical and competitive risk, not an obsolescence one. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price fair; Ratio B 0.36x; +107% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +1.60; conservative 2yr +122%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -2.0%/yr (worst year FY17-FY25 ex-FY18 ex-FY24, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +91.4%/yr (Q4 FY26 guide YoY + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr ex-FY18 ex-FY24 median

BULL.desc: EPS +91.4%/yr (FY17-FY25 ex-FY18 ex-FY24 CAGR, at least BASE); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +104.6%/yr (best 2-yr run FY17-FY25 ex-FY18 ex-FY24, at least BULL); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: AVGO (retrospective, 2026-10-30) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.36x (72.8% downside to Bear $88.85 / +199.7% upside to Bull $977.13) | Adj composite 3.10 vs market 1.50: gap +1.60 [UNDERVALUED] | +107% above the EPP floor $157.41 (33x FY26E $4.77) | Conservative 2-yr case: +122.1% total (+61.1%/yr) | At 68.4x FY26E the 15% hurdle price $431.24 sits at or below the BASE case; net revenue +85.5% YoY in Q3 FY26, forward revenues +93.2% (Q4 FY26 revenue guide (Q3 FY26 release)); cloud is live and company-acknowledged; no dated evidence ties the multiple to it.
